metadata.description: Multica CLI Skill marketplace — wrap the user's existing `multica login` config to script issue creation, query, update, comments, and attachments with Bash + curl + jq.

plugins.name: multica-cli-skill
plugins.description: Reuse the user's existing Multica CLI login (~/.multica/config.json) to create, query, and update Multica issues and manage comments and attachments via Bash + curl + jq. Fuzzy-matches assignees and projects by name. Works on Windows Git Bash, macOS, and Linux.
